Description
Founded in 1963, the University of York is a member of the prestigious Russell Group in the UK. York is a dynamic, research-intensive university with top quality programs across a wide range of academic areas. York is truly one of the elite universities in the UK and provides excellent teaching, research opportunities and student outcomes.
